summary: M5.S1 Al for Agents end-to-end test. All 8 backend pytest cases pass (chat plain msg, query_properties intent, monthly_performance intent, multi-tenancy isolation with second agency, sessions list/get/delete, P2 notranslate file check). Frontend E2E pass: FAB visible, widget opens, message sent, Italian assistant reply received, new-session clears messages, close restores FAB. P2 fix verified at runtime after frontend restart.

minor.issue: LLM 'Budget exceeded' (Emergent key cost cap) surfaces as raw 500 with generic 'Errore interno del server' instead of a typed 503/insufficient_credits. Caused 1 transient failure during first test run. Add try/except around LlmChat.send_message to return a clean detail.
Resend API rejects emails to non-owner addresses (test domain) — logged as ERROR but doesn't fail the flow. Use a verified domain or skip welcome in test mode.

ui_bugs.issue: Emergent preview badge (#emergent-badge, z-index:9999, bottom:16px/right:16px) intercepts pointer events on [data-testid='al-send'] because the widget sits at bottom-6/right-6 and the send button overlaps the badge's hit area. Only affects preview env (badge absent in production), but the FAB was already raised to bottom-24 for the same reason — the widget itself should similarly be lifted (e.g., bottom-24 or add padding-bottom 56px to footer) so the Invia button is not under the badge.

issues: Widget bottom-right corner overlaps with Emergent preview badge in preview env.

action_items: Lift the AlChatWidget container from bottom-6 to bottom-24 (or add pb-14 to its <form> footer) so the Invia button is not blocked by the Emergent preview badge in the preview environment.

Wrap LlmChat.send_message calls in al_agent.py with try/except → HTTPException(status_code=503, detail='llm_unavailable' or 'budget_exceeded') so users see a graceful Italian message instead of generic 500.
Note: Public/index.html changes require a frontend restart — webpack-dev-server does not hot-reload public/ templates. Document this for future P2-style edits.
critical_code_review_comments: al_agent.py replays history by re-sending each prior user message to the LLM on every turn (lines 216-218) — this is O(N) per request and incurs N× extra LLM cost for long sessions. Consider using LlmChat's built-in session_id + persistent history instead of replaying, or cap to last 2-3 turns.
Rate limit (60/h) check happens before LLM call but is not enforced on tool follow-up: the second send_message (line 240) costs additional LLM budget that's not counted against the limit.

system prompt asks LLM to output 'SOLO un JSON'. The _try_parse_tool_call() fallback that searches for first `{` to last `}` is fragile — if the LLM emits commentary then JSON, the parser may catch malformed substrings. Consider using a strict opening regex like /^\s*\{[\s\S]*\}\s*$/ with markdown fences allowed.

agency_id is taken via aids[0] in _agency_id; for users with multiple memberships this silently picks one. Should accept an agency_id header (validated against membership) or be documented as 'primary agency only'.
All Al endpoints lack OpenAPI response_model; responses are dict literals (e.g., {session_id, reply, tool_used, messages_count}). Add Pydantic response models for contract stability.

success_rate.backend: 100% (8/8 pytest after retry; 1 transient 500 due to Emergent LLM budget cap)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (FAB→open→send→receive Italian reply→new-session→close all worked once preview badge was hidden via JS)

context_for_next_testing_agent: P2 attrs require frontend restart after editing public/index.html (webpack-dev-server doesn't watch public/). The Emergent preview badge intercepts clicks on bottom-right of viewport — hide it via JS before testing widgets in that area, or main agent should lift the widget. Backend al/chat returns raw 500 if Emergent LLM key budget is exceeded; retry the test or top up the key.
rca of the issue: (a) Preview UI block on send button: emergent-badge has z-index 9999 at bottom:16/right:16 and overlaps al-send (which sits inside a widget anchored at bottom-6/right-6). Reproduction: open widget → try clicking Invia → Playwright reports '<a id=emergent-badge> intercepts pointer events'. Mitigation: raise widget to bottom-24 (same approach used for FAB) or add bottom padding to widget footer. (b) P2 attrs missing at runtime: webpack-dev-server caches public/index.html on startup; editing it requires `supervisorctl restart frontend` to pick up changes. After restart, all 4 P2 attrs (html translate=no, html lang=it, body class=notranslate, meta google=notranslate) are present at runtime.
